options.text: One heavy band and one light band. The old helix is kept whole and a new one is built beside it.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Keep the original, make a copy."

options.text: One band, exactly halfway between heavy and light. Every helix is half old, half new.
One band, halfway, but made of helices where old and new are mixed in patches along each strand.

image.alt: Bacteria grown on heavy nitrogen then shifted to light nitrogen for one division, DNA spun in a tube forming distinct density bands.
